meta.title: Logical teleportation of a Steane-code qubit

paper.title: High-fidelity teleportation of a logical qubit using transversal gates and lattice surgery

meta.summary: Teleportation of a Steane-code [[7,1,3]] logical qubit on Quantinuum's H2, with up to 30 ions, by transversal gates and by lattice surgery.
meta.program: An encoded logical program on the compiler's own Steane [[7,1,3]] declaration (riscq/ftqvm/papers.mjs quantinuumTeleport): a Bell pair between two logical ancilla blocks (|+⟩_L, |0⟩_L and a `transversal CX`), one stabilizer round on each, a `transversal CX` from the source block, the source read in X and the first ancilla in Z, then Pauli-frame corrections on the target. The compiler's staged back end compiles it with `pipeline-loops`.
meta.twin: Quantinuum H2 as QCCD Studio models it (arch/h2_racetrack.arch.json): a race track of 2 × 20 trap zones in one loop, no junctions, two ions per zone; MS 25 µs, one-qubit gate 5 µs and measurement 120 µs from the H2 paper (arXiv:2305.03828); split and merge 80 µs, 5 µs per shuttled zone and reset 50 µs from arXiv:2510.23519. Every two-qubit gate first carries its second ion around the loop to its partner's zone; `route` needs nothing. Run at H2's 32 qubits (2023) and at 56 qubits (2024, arXiv:2406.02501).
findings: On the 32-qubit H2, the compiler refuses the program: a request of 26 ancillas exceeds its live-qubit budget of 19. Its background maintenance reserves measure qubits for every live block, so this three-block teleportation needs more qubits than the up to 30 ions the paper ran it on.
On the 56-qubit H2 every operation ran inside its listed window: 39 ions placed, 611 operations, three iterations of the derivation.

The interface's routes license groups larger than an H2 zone holds (a Steane check routes its ancilla with four data ions; zones hold two), so on this twin transport moves into the two-qubit gate and `route` costs nothing. The derived two-qubit gate is then 295 µs: the worst trip half way round the track plus the MS gate. A gate whose pair already shares a zone needs 35 µs, the median gate 215 µs.
The Steane code's checks are decoded by the controller's lookup decoder in 154 to 428 ns, as Quantinuum decodes the Steane code with lookup tables.
limits: Only the transversal teleportation is reproduced; the lattice-surgery variant is not yet written.
Transport is planned gate by gate. H2 moves its ions as one conveyor belt driven by three voltage signals; that synchronization is not modeled, nor is sympathetic cooling.
The 56-qubit run keeps the 40-zone track of QCCD Studio's 32-qubit model; the zone layout of the 56-qubit device is not modeled.

rows.programText:
codes:
  Steane [[7,1,3]]:
    stab    X[3]X[4]X[5]X[6]
    stab    X[1]X[2]X[5]X[6]
    stab    X[0]X[2]X[4]X[6]
    stab    Z[3]Z[4]Z[5]Z[6]
    stab    Z[1]Z[2]Z[5]Z[6]
    stab    Z[0]Z[2]Z[4]Z[6]
    logX[0] X[0]X[1]X[2]
    logZ[0] Z[0]Z[1]Z[2]
  merged1 = canonical_product base=Steane factors=1 requires=commuting_factors(P) blocks=distinct(family,block) n=sum(n)+1 k=sum(k)-rank(P_mod_base_checks) distance=unclaimed ancillas=1 checks=(base_checks,P*X[a],X[a]) check_signs=decoded_outcomes check_scope=(P*X[a],X[a]) check_prepare=|+> check_read=X split=Z
  merged2 = canonical_product base=Steane factors=2 requires=commuting_factors(P) blocks=distinct(family,block) n=sum(n)+1 k=sum(k)-rank(P_mod_base_checks) distance=unclaimed ancillas=1 checks=(base_checks,P*X[a],X[a]) check_signs=decoded_outcomes check_scope=(P*X[a],X[a]) check_prepare=|+> check_read=X split=Z
  merged3 = canonical_product base=Steane factors=3 requires=commuting_factors(P) blocks=distinct(family,block) n=sum(n)+1 k=sum(k)-rank(P_mod_base_checks) distance=unclaimed ancillas=1 checks=(base_checks,P*X[a],X[a]) check_signs=decoded_outcomes check_scope=(P*X[a],X[a]) check_prepare=|+> check_read=X split=Z

program[LogicData: 1, c: 12, ancilla: 60] (Steane[1] LogicData, Steane[2] LogicalAncilla):
  alloc LogicalAncilla[0,2)
  prepare |+> -> LogicalAncilla[0,1)
  prepare |0> -> LogicalAncilla[1,2)
  transversal CX LogicalAncilla[0] LogicalAncilla[1]
  extract LogicalAncilla[0][0] rounds=1 using ancilla[0,6) -> syndrome[0,6)
  extract LogicalAncilla[1][0] rounds=1 using ancilla[6,12) -> syndrome[6,12)
  decode rounds=1 syndrome[0,12)
  transversal CX LogicData[0] LogicalAncilla[0]
  measure X[LogicData[0][0]] -> c[0,3)
  measure Z[LogicalAncilla[0][0]] -> c[3,6)
  decode rounds=1 c[0,6)
  frame on c[0,3) Z[LogicalAncilla[1][0]]
  frame on c[3,6) X[LogicalAncilla[1][0]]
